abstemious: Abs + temetum: wine-free. An abstemious diet.
affectation: Affectare: aim at. Affectation of accent.
aggrandize: Ad + grandis: make grand. Aggrandize himself.
assiduous: Assidere: sit by. An assiduous student.
bilk: Bilk: cheat at cards. Bilked of savings.
cogitate: Co + agitare: turn over. Cogitate on it.
diaphanous: Dia + phainein: show through. Diaphanous silk.
distend: Dis + tendere: stretch apart. Distended belly.
expedient: Expedire: free the feet. An expedient fix.
forestall: Fore + stall: ambush. Forestall a crisis.
insuperable: In + superare: not surmountable. An insuperable obstacle.
inveigle: Aveugle: blind. Inveigle him into it.
legerdemain: Léger de main: light of hand. Legerdemain with cards.
malediction: Male + dicere: speak ill. Hurl a malediction.
malinger: Malingre: sickly. Malinger to skip class.
pallid: Pallere: be pale. A pallid face.
pastiche: Pasticcio: pie mix. A Mozart pastiche.
recalcitrance: Re + calx: heel. Recalcitrance of staff.
requite: Re + quit: pay back. Requited love.
ruminate: Ruminare: chew cud. Ruminate on a choice.
transgression: Trans + gradi: step across. A minor transgression.
welter: Welter: roll. A welter of rules.
